measurement_attribution.scope: Accepted raw observations only. New finite relation remains to be implemented/reviewed. Query consumed once and never imported/replayed by production.

relation_policy.arrays: Compare reported element reference and subrange count/index-type metadata only; no fabricated array byte_size/alignment.
relation_policy.base_binding: Each shash_alg.base must reference the exact same-role selected crypto_alg node through only explicitly present approved type edges; names/sizes alone insufficient.
relation_policy.complete_candidate_rule: Exactly one source-qualified CU and exactly one candidate for each target/type/prototype per role, unique raw node identity and graph closure. Structure completeness derives from structure tag, correct name, positive byte_size, explicit direct members and expanded boundary, never from a passed/complete marker.
relation_policy.declaration_role: Provider declaration marker and core marker absence are recorded distinctly; those markers need not be equal and do not prove machine-code ownership/calling convention.
relation_policy.graph_safety: Unique CU-qualified IDs, exact same-role resolved references/ordered children, complete reachable closed finite graph; reject foreign role/CU, duplicate IDs, missing nodes, unrelated extra nodes, unsupported tags/attrs/forms, unapproved cycles/edge kinds or cap excess. Cycle handling is visited node-pairs, no unbounded recursion.
relation_policy.opaque_scope: Stop at each explicitly approved opaque structure/union pair. Compare only reported tag/name/byte_size/alignment presence/value, emit path and by-value/pointee context and internal-layout-unmeasured status. Opaque presence alone is not a finite-relation failure; no children invented or transitive layout guarantee.
relation_policy.pointer_scope: Compare reported pointer tag/type edge and qualifier placement, plus common selected CU address-size metadata. Explicit pointer byte_size is absent in all observed pointer records and stays unknown; never infer measured pointer size or full member storage extent.
relation_policy.prototypes: Both registration candidates and callback subroutine types must retain prototyped flag and positional formal type graph/order/count. Ignore formal parameter names and declaration locations. Compare return-reference presence/type exactly; absent callback return reference is reported as absence without inventing a void DIE or measured return storage.
relation_policy.recorded_count_markers: Recompute all counts and candidate/opaque/graph conditions from records; count/status fields are never verification data.
relation_policy.top_structures: Compare reported structure byte_size and direct member order/name/start offsets, reported member alignments and finite reported type graphs. Report absent own shash_alg alignment as unknown; do not infer from member alignment, size or padding.
relation_policy.typedef_const_scope: Preserve exact reported typedef names and const wrappers/reference placement. No qualifier erasure or pointer/pointee collapse. No volatile/restrict tags observed in this profile, so no automatic extension to them.
